text: I've got one feeling in my chest tonight
Not a hundred stories fighting for the light
Hope after a week that wore me thin
That's the door I'm walking in
If a line don't carry what I mean
I let it go, I keep it clean
One feeling, one promise, that's the song
Hold it steady, don't take too long
Tomorrow can still be yours to claim
Say it plain, then sing the name
Tired hands and a quiet morning sky
I don't need a reason, I just try
No extra glitter, no borrowed scene
Just the truth of what I mean
Cut the noise, keep the core
Feeling first, then give it more
Promise once, then say it clear
So anybody's heart can hear
Win, then rule, then show the way
Leave a next step they can play
One feeling, one promise… start today
